title: Blood Meridian
author: Cormac McCarthy
summary: A teenage runaway known only as the kid joins a gang of scalp hunters on the Texas-Mexico borderlands in the 1850s. The gang's most terrifying member is the learned, pale Judge Holden.
readIf: you want an extremely violent, mythic, poetic western that treats America's frontier as a place of horror.
skipIf: you are sensitive to graphic violence; it is relentless and the prose is dense.

pairings.reason: McCarthy's later, sparser book, with the same fixation on violence but a tender father-and-son centre.
Another western epic that treats the same era with warmth and humour rather than horror.
Another novel in which a charismatic, terrifying figure embodies the moral emptiness of conquest.
